A1.claim: Every estimator but the approximate hero's view is unbiased (|bias| < 1e-9)

A2.claim: Sampled hands agree with the exact moments: no |z| > 4, mean-z p >= 0.01, median sampled/exact SD in [0.97, 1.03]

B1.claim: AIVAT, equilibrium hero: median ratio >= 15x and every bot >= 5x

B2.claim: AIVAT, exploiting hero: median ratio between 3x and 8x

B3.claim: Oracle values beat equilibrium values for the equilibrium hero by >= 1.4x

C1.claim: Hero's view (folded cards hidden): median ratio < 1.15x for both heroes

C2.claim: Approximate hero's view: median ratio in [1.4x, 2.5x] for both heroes, and its bias reaches >= 0.02 chips/hand against some bot (exploiting hero)

D1.claim: Uniform-play values still give AIVAT a median ratio >= 4x (equilibrium hero)

D2.claim: From 30 CFR+ iterations on, AIVAT's median ratio is within 20% of the equilibrium values' (equilibrium hero)

E1.claim: Duplicate dealing adds < 25% on top of AIVAT (equilibrium hero)

F1.claim: Push/fold: exact SDs of all-in EV and duplicate + all-in EV within 3% of P3.3's sampled SDs in every matchup

F2.claim: Push/fold, Nash hero: AIVAT needs >= 4x fewer hands than all-in EV at every stack (median over bots)

F3.claim: Push/fold: hero's view gains < 1.3x over all-in EV at every stack, both heroes
